thread:
kevin (Eng Manager): Need quick clarity: we missed the appeal window for an L4->L5 promo by a week. Manager has new evidence. Any way to escalate?
nora (People Ops): Short: appeals after 30 days need an exec sponsor and clear new evidence. For late submissions under 45 days we can do a fast pre-check.
jamie (Compensation): If it's <45 days, submit the packet via /forms/comp-change-request and tag it 'Late: pre-check requested'. We'll review for material new evidence.
alex (HRBP): Managers should include why evidence wasn't available earlier and an explicit director endorsement. That helps the exec sponsor assess urgency.
kevin (Eng Manager): If we get director sign-off today, who is the exec sponsor typically?
nora (People Ops): Usually the org VP. If that's not feasible, ask your director to escalate to the People Ops lead for triage.
payroll-bot: FYI: retro pay only processed if approved before payroll cutoff (10th). Otherwise it posts next month.
jamie (Compensation): Also: if the request changes equity, expect extra lead time. Put that in the packet so managers know expected timelines.
kevin (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll gather the new evidence and director note, then submit. Appreciate the quick answers.
nora (People Ops): Please DM me once submitted and we'll list it for the next expedited review.
